# Soumik Chatterjee

> AI Specialist working remotely from Kolkata. Claude workflows, AI automation and community support. Built TriageOps, an AI service desk, with Claude Code.

AI Specialist, Startup and EdTech Clients (Contract engagements), Feb 2026 to present. Clients include God Crew (Toronto), Navgurukul Foundation, Vokido (UK), Simplilearn and Masters' Union. Ex-Accenture, CampK12, Teach For India.

Soumik Chatterjee is looking for a full-time role in community and member support, Claude workflows or AI training, working remotely from Kolkata, India. He can start immediately.

## Results

- TriageOps, an AI service desk for IT managed service providers, built solo with Claude Code and live in under an hour on 4 Nov 2026. Claude reads each ticket in under six seconds, fixed rules keep ransomware at the top, and 896 automated tests run on every push. Live demo at https://triageops.vercel.app.
- 9 prospecting pipelines built within 90 days for a Toronto founder (Feb 2026 to present), feeding one dashboard that tracks 2,314 prospects across 924 companies and $1.47M CAD of pipeline. The founder estimates 20 to 30 hours a month saved.
- Recruitment and Operations Manager at CampK12 (2020 to 2023), with a 400+ instructor workforce matched to client accounts in India, the US, UK, UAE and Australia. Manual outreach down 30%, client retention above 90%.
- Python automation frameworks for Bank of America and UCI Hospital at Accenture (Apr 2015 to Mar 2019). Post-deployment defects down 15%.
- 31 hiring partners signed against a target of 25 at Navgurukul Foundation (Mar to Apr 2026), 2,093 companies contacted.
- 14 live tools, 12 AI tools and 2 Chrome extensions, all free. Blur Background has 300+ users and Full Webpage Screenshot 30+.
- 1,200+ students mentored since 2016. Teaching Assistant on the Oxford Programmes in AI via Simplilearn, including Strategic Analysis and Decision-Making with AI (Oct 2026 to present, part time).
- Volunteer Community Contributor in the AI Automation Society on Skool since Oct 2026.
- B.Tech in Computer Science, CIEM (WBUT), 2014. PG Certificate in Data Science and Engineering, Great Lakes Institute, 2020. Claude Certified Architect, Foundations, in progress.
